thread:
lina: T-minus 5 for today's change window. Quick checklist: smoke, canary staging check, rollback thresholds. RN: https://internal.releases/redwood/1.6.3
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @lina. Start=2026-05-10T18:00:00Z. Plan: canary 2% x 6m -> 15% x 10m -> 100%. Pin bump v3.6.0 -> v3.6.1. Pins will be locked during rollout.
joel: Staging smoke green. gen p95=105ms p99=160ms errors=0.05%.
mia: Dashboards and synthetic checks are set. Alerting: page @oncall-us for 5xx >0.5% sustained 3m or p99 +35% for 5m. I'll monitor.
lina: Rollback gates reminder: immediate rollback if 5xx >0.6% for 3m or p99 +40% for 5m or critical customer errors. Rollback target v3.6.0.
oncall-us: If thresholds hit I'll run rollback playbook. Owners: oncall-us(rollback), joel(traces), mia(monitoring), release-manager(comms).
deploy-bot: Canary guard: pause and alert if canary error-rate >0.4% for two consecutive windows. No auto rollback for canary-only anomalies.
joel: Heads-up: there may be transient kvcache WARNs during prefix warmup. We've added a log filter to reduce noise.
lina: Locking pins now -> /deploy lock-pins
deploy-bot: Pins locked by @lina. Unpin requires release-manager + oncall-us approval.
lina: Any objections?
joel: good to go
mia: ready
release-manager: ready to publish after success
oncall-us: standing by
deploy-bot: Rollout started. Phase=canary 2% (6m). SLO guardrails active.
lina: Smoke checks during canary: /health, sample chat, embeddings sanity (10 queries).
joel: Canary minute 3: errors 0.04% p99 162ms. Slight expected tail.
mia: Dashboards stable. No error clusters.
oncall-us: Increasing alert sensitivity for 20m.
deploy-bot: Canary advanced to 15% at +6m.
lina: Monitor redis connections and kvcache miss ratio, TTLs changed.
joel: Connections spiked at start, normalized after warmup, no errors.
release-manager: Drafted customer note; will publish after full success.
lina: Preferred rollback command if needed:
/deploy rollback --to v3.6.0 --reason "threshold breach"
oncall-us: If I trigger rollback I'll post timestamps and hold redeploy until retro.
deploy-bot: Rollout completed: status success. Regions green. Pins remain locked.
lina: Change window closed. Release-manager publish RN + customer comms. Mini-retro tomorrow for kvcache follow-ups.
release-manager: RN published, image tagged, telemetry checkpoint created, runbook updated.
joel: Follow-up: watch p99 for 24h for warm-start tail.
mia: Adding extended dashboard and playbook note.
lina: Thanks team, smooth rollout. :rocket:
